withdrawal_reason: INVALID. This minimised over binary-prefix centres subject to covering only binary-prefix ORBITS, so the resulting "cover" does not cover all of U. Restricting the constraint set LOWERS the primal optimum, so the value is a lower bound on the true fractional covering number and NOT the upper bound a row-end requires. Checked directly against the unreduced LP at five small cells: my value sits BELOW the true tau* at four of them, e.g. N=6 r=4 m=3 gives 2.43355054 against a true 3.51724138.
what_survives: Nothing of the row-end claim. The dual certificates in cert_*.json are unaffected: a feasible dual bounds tau* from below whatever its support, and their ball constraints were checked over all centres by a reduction that is valid precisely because their support is binary.
